anika: quick update from the token-pool smoothing sweep i ran this morning for APAC(syd) vs EU(fra) on H100/A100 :bar_chart:

anika: tl;dr — smoothing (alpha=0.6) reduces tail latency for small-tenant traffic without hurting peak throughput; kernel choice matters more on A100 when seq_len > 1024. attaching perf snippets and a small config i used.

leo: nice — can you paste the p50/p95 numbers? also which kernel names exactly?

anika: p50/p95 (syd H100, 4x8g pods): default (no-smooth) = 12ms / 142ms, smoothing alpha=0.6 = 13ms / 95ms. throughput (tokens/s) at 95th percentile load: default 42k, smooth 40k.

sasha: wow, 47% drop in 95 tail — that's solid. what's the trade on large-batched requests?

anika: large single-tenant batches (batch_tokens ~ 1e6) saw ~2-3% throughput drop on H100, ~6-8% on A100. A100 regressions correlated with falling back to kernel "kv_mmap_small" for >1024 seq. H100 used fast_attn_v2 consistently.

jay: can you share the exact bench command? i'll triage kernel selection on infra side.

anika: sure — run like this:
```
REDW_BENCH_REGION=syd 
MODEL_NAME=mosaic-13b-quant 
BACKEND_KERNELS=fast_attn_v2,kv_mmap_small 
POOLING_MODE=token_pool_smooth 
SMOOTH_ALPHA=0.6 
./bench/run_load_test --concurrency 200 --duration 10m --max-seq 2048 --trace-kernel
```

bench-bot: automated note: run 1735001234 completed 2024-05-02T09:12Z, artifacts: https://redwood-ci/internal/runs/1735001234 (perf CSV + flamegraphs)

leo: i'll look at the flamegraphs. any anomalies on KV-cache miss rates?

anika: small bump in KV miss for smoothing (expected due to interleaving), ~4% higher at p95, but prefix-cache hit stayed >92% for high-frequency tenants.

sasha: did you try alpha sweep? what's the sweet spot?

anika: yes — alpha 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8. 0.4 reduced p95 by ~30% with <2% throughput hit; 0.6 gave best tail at ~33% p95 reduction but ~4-6% throughput cost depending on gpu. 0.8 starts to impact p50 noticeably.

jay: region differences — how did EU(FRA) compare?

anika: EU FRA H100 numbers similar but ~8-10ms higher baseline due to network tail; smoothing gave comparable % improvements. A100 in FRA showed bigger kernel switch penalties — need kernel fallback tuning there.

leo: do we need automatic kernel-override rules in scheduler? e.g., prefer fast_attn_v2 for seq>1024 on A100 to avoid kv_mmap_small fallback?

sasha: cautious — forcing a kernel might increase OOM risk for some model variants. maybe a GRACEFUL fallback: scheduler attempts preferred kernel and if evictions increase >X in 5m, rollback.

anika: agree. proposal: add kernel_hint to route policy + safety monitor for eviction rate and avg mem pressure. i can prototype.

jay: also let's add a per-region bench matrix to the onboarding checklist: H100/A100, seq buckets (<=512, 512-1024, >1024), smoothing alpha 0/0.4/0.6.

bench-bot: note saved to onboarding checklist: https://redwood-internal/docs/onboard/bench-matrix (entry id 2024-APAC-EU-TP01)

leo: can we get a quick viz? a small chart with p95 vs throughput points for each alpha would help PMs.

anika: uploaded a 2-panel png in the run artifacts (see bench-bot link). will drop into #eng-ml-docs later.

sasha: thanks — next steps: anika to prototype kernel_hint + safety monitor; jay to check infra kernel selectors on A100 fleet; leo to review flamegraphs; i'll add notes to the evals doc. :thumbsup:

anika: on it. i'll post a short PR with results and config within 48h.

jay: ping me when PR is up, i'll run a quick smoke across fra and syd.

bench-bot: reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in #eng-ml next Tue 10:00 PT to review PR 1735001234-TP01
